notes: Throughput is the vendor 'appmix' figure (App-ID + logging). Threat Prevention throughput adds IPS, AV, anti-spyware, WildFire, file blocking and logging.

Interface lists come from datasheets. Port numbering (which ethernet1/N is which media) is assumed in datasheet order unless ports_verified is true. Check the hardware reference guide and edit the target port list in the tool if needed.
Status and end-of-sale dates are recomputed in the tool from eos_date against today's date.

Power supply counts (psu) and dedicated HA port types (ha_ports) come from hardware references and datasheets; where sources disagree the model's psu.note says so. A null means not in the sources we read.
HA ports: models with no dedicated HA port (PA-400, PA-500 and others) use a data port for HA links. HA1 is the control link, HA2 the data link; HSCI carries HA2/HA3 on models that have it.

Capacity limits (limits): from the Palo Alto datasheet capacity tables as copied on a reseller site (an older revision: some session counts differ from the current datasheet), plus Palo Alto KB articles for GlobalProtect tunnels and older rule counts. A missing key means not published in the sources we read; check the Product Comparison tool.

Rack facts (RU, size, weight, airflow, watts, BTU) are series figures from datasheets. Rail kits and mounting hardware are not in the sources: confirm on the quote. Power inlet type and wattage are in each model's psu block.
